summary: The note describes how the town of Clearview overhauled its financial management to be more transparent and accountable, starting with Mayor Jane Holloway's announcement on September 5, 2023. Measures include a cloud-based system built with SoftLedger Inc., stakeholder meetings, mandatory staff training, revised fiscal policies advised by external auditors, and a new public communication strategy. It also covers revenue diversification and presents Clearview as a model for other municipalities.
one_line: Clearview's 2023-2024 overhaul of local financial management used new technology, training, policy revisions and public communication to improve transparency and accountability.
key_facts: On September 5, 2023, at Clearview Town Hall, Mayor Jane Holloway announced an initiative to overhaul the town's financial management systems.
Council member James Walker noted at a September 15 closed-door meeting a 27% increase in public records requests for financial documents in the past year.
On October 10, 2023, the Clearview Town Council and SoftLedger Inc. launched a cloud-based, real-time financial management system replacing paper-based bookkeeping.
The system's dashboard shows expenditures, revenue streams, and budget performance indicators, and is accessible to all council members and key administrative staff.
A Town Hall meeting on November 3, 2023 gathered resident and stakeholder feedback on the new financial systems.
Linda Alvarez, a finance professor and Clearview resident, advised on how to make financial statements and records more easily accessible to the public.
From December 1, 2023, Clearview's local government began mandatory employee training seminars on ethical standards in public finance, transparency regulations, and use of the new system.
CFO Carol Thompson leads the seminars and says "training is an investment in our town's future."
External auditors from Blakely & Garrison LLP advised on updated procurement policies, budgeting processes, and financial reporting standards, revisions that began in mid-January 2024.
New budgetary controls include regular variance analysis reports to detect deviations from the budget early.
A communication strategy rolled out in early February 2024 includes quarterly financial summaries, interactive online forums, and scheduled press briefings.
Spokesperson Elise Donnelly was appointed to manage inquiries and share information via social media and the local government website.
Several town-sponsored projects are earmarked for completion by the end of the second quarter of 2024, funded by tax revenue and public-private ventures.
